cvEn:
Nisim Mizrahi, son of Roza and Ovadia, was born on the 11th of Nisan 5697 (23 March 1937) in Jerusalem. He completed his studies at the "Nahshon" elementary school. He then joined the youth group at Kibbutz Naan, where he stayed for about four years. Encouraged by his adoptive father at the kibbutz, he learned plumbing and became a plumber.

Nisim was drafted into the IDF in January 1956 and served in the Maintenance Corps.

On the 13th of Tevet 5717 (17 December 1956), he fell while carrying out his duties, transporting captured ammunition from Sinai to the north of the country during Operation Kadesh. Nisim was laid to rest in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl in Jerusalem. He was eighteen years old when he fell. He left behind parents, four brothers and four sisters.
